title: Anita DeFrantz, Who Rowed Her Way Into Olympic History, Dies at 74
summary: She was the first Black woman to win an Olympic medal in rowing. She then became a relentless advocate for women’s inclusion in the Olympics.

title: Andrea Stewart-Cousins, New York’s First Female Senate Majority Leader, Dies
summary: Ms. Stewart-Cousins, 76, served in the State Senate for 20 years. Her sudden death leaves a leadership void among top state Democrats.
caption: Ms. Stewart-Cousins, the majority leader of the New York State Senate, at a leadership reception on Nov. 7, 2025.
authors: Benjamin Oreskes, Maya King and Dana Rubinstein

title: For One Stormy Moment, D.C. Reveled in a Blank Wall Where Trump’s Name Once Hung
summary: High winds dislodged a section of tarp obscuring the removal of the president’s name from the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts, whipping up some members of the capital.
caption: A tarp covered the facade of the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts in September.
tags: Kennedy, John F, Center for the Performing Arts

title: Planning Board to Hold Last-Minute Meeting to Consider Trump’s D.C. Construction
summary: President Trump will lose control over the National Capital Planning Commission after Democrats take control of Congress in January. It could give final approval to some of his prized projects.
caption: East Potomac Park last month, one of the sites of President Trump’s proposed construction projects around the city.

title: Supreme Court Rulings Cheered by Republicans Wound Up Hurting Them
summary: Decisions on voting rights, immigration and corruption generated a backlash that helped spur turnout that drove the Democratic sweep of Congress.
caption: Other Supreme Court rulings influenced the election as well, including a decision allowing construction of the White House ballroom to continue.

title: Some Americans canceled or postponed Thanksgiving dinners amid power outages and storms.
summary: Some Americans canceled or postponed Thanksgiving dinners amid power outages and storms. They were rescheduled to Friday, Saturday and beyond.
caption: Parade floats were lined up on Manhattan’s Upper West Side, where the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed because of weather. Storms forced many Americans to change Thanksgiving plans on Thursday.
authors: Katie Benner, Mack Liederman and Emma Schartz

title: Thanksgiving Storm Leaves More Than 400,000 Without Power on the East Coast
summary: Conditions continued to improve on Friday after heavy rain and strong winds lashed the coast from Virginia to New York. But many remained without power and travel disruptions persisted.
caption: A downed tree crushes a car during a rain storm near the Van Ness neighborhood in Washington D.C. on Thursday.
authors: Qasim Nauman, Francesca Regalado and Amanda Holpuch

title: Princess Kate’s Cancer Documentary ‘Heal’: 3 Takeaways
summary: ‘Heal,’ a 30-minute authorized documentary released this week, offers glimpses into Catherine’s recovery since her 2024 cancer diagnosis and treatment.
caption: Catherine, Princess of Wales, touring a hospital wing in Bordon, England, in November.

title: Trump’s Embrace of Xi and Huang Stuns China Critics in Washington
summary: Warnings from hard-liners have grown more urgent amid what some call a winner-take-all race for A.I. dominance.
